results.title: Kitchen come true
results.creator_credit: ONF | NFB, Ernest Reid, Betty Brunke and Alvin Armstrong
results.brief_description: Demonstrates how an old fashioned farm kitchen may be updated into a modern and convenient 1945 kitchen through careful planning and efficient conversion of existing space and materials. During the planning stage, the following are considered: saving steps in the kitchen; provision of adequate shelf space; facilitating house cleaning; provision of ample laundry space; washing and cleaning area; and a well-lit desk for children’s homework. Shows the planning, design, construction and enjoyment of a new kitchen.

results.title: Kiss Me Petruchio (Captioned)
results.brief_description: This is a funny, fast-paced documentary based on the New York Shakespeare Festival’s production of “The Taming of the Shrew”. starring Meryl Streep and Raul Julia. results.title: Kipling's India
results.creator_credit: Alan Bateman, Australian Broadcasting Commission and Lloyd Capps
results.brief_description: 19th century author, Rudyard Kipling spent the first six years of his life in Bombay where his father taught sculpture. After schooling in Britain, he returned to India to work for seven years as a journalist before returning forever to England to write full time. Although he never returned to India, Kipling never lost his delight in the romance, mystery and endless variety of Indian life. India formed his imagination and provided his best themes. In this program, Keith Adam retraces the journey of Kipling’s character Kim, to locate traces of the old India Kipling loved, and in doing so exposes us to the fascination of India.

results.title: Kip and David. Episode 13.
results.creator_credit: Corinne Cantrill, Arthur Cantrill and Firebird Films
results.brief_description:
Episode number 13 of Series “Kip and David”.
Kip and David return to the island. The kookaburras, magpies and currawongs welcome Kip back and David feeds these wild birds. They explore a steep rocky gorge in which many Pandanus trees are growing and see giant turtles swimming. Kip and David watch the rock crabs feeding but the tide is coming in, so they leave the gorge and visit one of the ocean headlands. David promises to visit Kip whenever he can. Music by Nancy Tow. Narrated by Roy Dunlop.

results.title: Kip and David. Episode 12.
results.creator_credit: Corinne Cantrill, Arthur Cantrill and Firebird Films
results.brief_description:
Episode number 12 of Series “Kip and David”.
Spring has arrived to David’s garden and Kip is feeling homesick for his island. David promises to take Kip back next time they return for a holiday. They set off to explore an old quarry, where they meet a geology student searching for fossils in the shale deposits. They find excellent fossils of plants and ripple patterns. David tries to use a geologist’s hammer and find a fossil to take home. Music by Nancy Tow. Narrated by Roy Dunlop.
